project_name: Barangay Health Center – Patient Profiling and Record Management System
archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & HEALTHCARE PRECISION (Trust, Care, Professional Clarity)

typography.font_body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

rules.headings: Use font-semibold or font-bold with tracking-tight. Never use Inter for headers.
rules.numbers: Stat card numbers must be text-3xl or text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900.
rules.labels: Overlines and metadata uppercase tracking-wider text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500.

entry_surfaces./: split screen login — brand hero visual + emergency hotline & Barangay credentials left, pristine healthcare login form with role switcher (Admin / Health Worker) right
entry_surfaces./login: split screen login — brand hero visual + emergency hotline & Barangay credentials left, pristine healthcare login form with role switcher (Admin / Health Worker) right

sidebar.width: w-64 (256px) on desktop, collapsible sheet on mobile
sidebar.style: Dark teal solid background (#0B2B28) with Barangay Official Gold badge/seal, crisp 1px borders, active navigation indicator with teal highlight and gold accent dot
sidebar.footer: Current logged-in user pill (Role badge, name, avatar) + Logout action with confirmation

header.style: Sticky top-0 z-30 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-[#E2ECE9] px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs
elements: Global quick patient search with keyboard shortcut (/)
System live status badge ('Barangay Health Center - Active Shift')
Quick Action button (+ New Consultation / + Register Patient)

layouts_and_navigation.main_container: bg-[#F4F7F6] min-h-[calc(100vh-65px)] p-6 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6

login.layout: 50/50 split on desktop, stacked on mobile
login.left_panel: Deep teal gradient with medical clinic photography backdrop, official Barangay Health Office insignia with gold shield, mission highlights (Zero Maternal Mortality, 100% Child Immunization Coverage, 24/7 Health Records), quick emergency hotline card
login.right_panel: Crisp card with Barangay logo, System Name, Quick Demo Account Selector pills (Admin vs Health Worker for 1-click test fill), Username/Email, Password, Remember Me, Forgot Password dialog, Login button, Philippine DOH Compliance Notice

charts_row.donut_chart: Patients by Age Group (0-5 Infants, 6-17 Children/Youth, 18-59 Adults, 60+ Senior Citizens) using Recharts with custom tooltips
charts_row.line_chart: Monthly Consultations & Vaccinations Trend (Jan - Dec) with interactive toggle between Total Visits and Immunizations

bottom_row.recent_consultations_table: Recent 6 patient consultations with Patient Name, Purok/Address, Purpose (e.g. Prenatal, EPI Vaccine, Hypertension Check), Attending Health Worker, Status Badge (Completed / In-Progress), and Action button
bottom_row.quick_links_panel: Immediate action shortcuts: + New Patient Registration, + Log Vital Signs, + Schedule Immunization, + Prenatal Checkup Form, Export Monthly DOH Report

filters: Filter by Category (General, Maternal, Pediatric, Senior, PWD)
patients_list.table: Columns: Patient ID, Full Name, Age/Sex, Purok, PhilHealth No., Category Badges, Last Visit Date, Status, Actions (View Full Profile, Edit, Log Visit)
patients_list.dialog_create: Modal to register a new resident with basic demographics, PhilHealth, emergency contact, Purok, blood type, allergies

patient_profile.layout: Left sticky card (Patient Photo/Avatar, PhilHealth ID, QR code badge, Vital summary, Emergency contacts, Quick action buttons) + Right Tabs panel
tabs: Overview & Vitals History (Blood pressure, BMI, Blood sugar trends)
Immunization & Vaccination Records (Date, Vaccine batch, Administered by)
Prescriptions & Medicines Issued (Dispensed from Barangay inventory)

maternal_care.header_stats: Total Pregnant, High-Risk Pregnancies, Due This Month, Postpartum Monitored
maternal_care.features: Trimester tracker, Expected Date of Delivery (EDD) countdown, Prenatal visit milestones (1st-4th Trimester checkups), Tetanus Toxoid vaccination status, Iron/Folate supplement tracking, High-risk flag badge

pediatric_immunization.header_stats: Total Children (0-59 mos), Fully Immunized Children (FIC Rate %), Pending Vaccinations This Week, Underweight/Malnourished Monitored
pediatric_immunization.features: DOH Mandatory Immunization Schedule Matrix (BCG, Hep B, Pentavalent 1-3, OPV/IPV 1-3, PCV 1-3, MMR 1-2), Growth Monitoring (Weight-for-Age, Height-for-Age charts), Vitamin A & Deworming logs

health_records.features: Comprehensive clinical log search, diagnosis categorization (Communicable, Non-Communicable, Maternal, Pediatric), ICD-10 compatible labels, Medical certificate generator / Printable slip preview

visit_history.features: Chronological clinic triage log, date range selector, check-in time vs consultation time, consultation reason, vitals recorded at triage (BP, HR, RR, Temp, Weight), attending staff

reports_analytics.date_range: Quick presets: Today, This Week, This Month, This Quarter, Year-to-Date, Custom Range
visualizations: Consultation volume by Purok / Zone (Bar Chart)
Top 10 Morbidity / Leading Illnesses (Horizontal Bar Chart)
Maternal & Child Health Indicators (FIC Rate, Prenatal Attendance %)
reports_analytics.export_actions: Export Official DOH FHSIS Summary (CSV/Print/PDF modal format)

user_management.features: List of Health Center Staff (Admin, Barangay Health Worker - BHW, Nurse, Midwife, Doctor), Status toggle (Active/Inactive), Assign Purok jurisdiction, Role-based permissions, Add Staff Member modal

settings.features: Barangay Health Center Info (Center Name, Municipality, Province, Contact No., Head Medical Officer, Operating Hours), Backup & Export, System Preferences

image_urls.description: Doctor in clinic with stethoscope for login hero background and health center mission banner
Healthcare worker professional portrait for medical officer showcase
Medical stethoscope equipment still life for healthcare reports background

motion.page_transitions: Subtle opacity and slight y-axis slide (opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 6px -> 0px in 0.2s ease-out)
motion.stat_cards: Hover subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5) with transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s ease
motion.tab_switching: Smooth cross-fade with no layout jarring
motion.respect_reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential animations with prefers-reduced-motion media query checks

accessibility.focus_states: All buttons, inputs, links must have visible focus rings: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive triggers, inputs, filters, tabs, charts, and key stats MUST have unambiguous data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. BRANDING & THEME: Implement the modern healthcare dashboard palette. Use dark teal (#0B2B28) for the persistent left sidebar with the Gold Barangay Logo badge. Set page background to soft medical light gray/mint (#F4F7F6). Use crisp white cards (#FFFFFF) with rounded-xl border border-[#E2ECE9] and soft shadow-sm.

2. SEED DATA & AUTHENTICATION: Provide seeded demo accounts accessible via quick one-click selector on login: 'admin' / 'admin123' (Administrator) and 'healthworker' / 'worker123' (Barangay Health Worker). Seed realistic Philippine Barangay health data (Purok 1 to Purok 7, realistic Filipino names like Dela Cruz, Santos, Garcia, Reyes, PhilHealth IDs, prenatal records with EDD, EPI vaccination logs like BCG/Pentavalent/MMR, hypertension/diabetes vital history).

3. CHART INTEGRATION: Use Recharts (already pinned and available). Dashboard must feature: 1) Patients by Age Group Donut Chart with center label and color-coded legend, 2) Monthly Consultations line/area chart with smooth teal gradient stroke.

4. COMPLETE HEALTH MODULES: Provide full UI workflows for 1) Dashboard with 4 KPI stat cards, charts, recent consultations table & quick actions, 2) Patients directory with search/filters/pagination & Add Patient modal, 3) Detailed Patient Profile with multi-tab history, 4) Pregnant Women management with trimester/EDD tracker, 5) Pediatric/Baby Immunization matrix with vaccine checklists, 6) Health Records & Consultation logs with printable slip modal, 7) Visit History triage logs, 8) Reports with date range filters & Morbidity/Purok charts, 9) User Management for staff accounts, 10) Settings.

5. DATA-TESTID CONVENTION: Add explicit data-testid attributes on all critical elements (e.g. data-testid='login-username-input', data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='demo-admin-btn', data-testid='stat-card-total-patients', data-testid='patient-search-input', data-testid='add-patient-button', data-testid='tab-immunization', data-testid='nav-maternal', etc.).
6. ERROR RESILIENCE: Degrade gracefully if backend is offline; render empty states with friendly guidance and mock seed fallback to prevent broken blank screens.
